claim.claim_type: declaration | import | module | notation | theorem_shape | api_convention | math_context
claim.source_url: required if source_id is omitted; may be a retrieval-aid discovery URL only when official_corroboration_url is present
claim.query: search query or retrieval path that found the source
claim.declaration: required for declaration claims when known
claim.module: required for module/import claims when known
claim.official_corroboration_url: official mathlib docs/source URL required when a retrieval aid discovered the claim
